name: Standing Toe Touch Stretch
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and keep a very slight unlock in your knees.
Hinge slowly forward from your hips, letting your torso fold down smoothly as your hands reach toward your shins, ankles, or toes.
Relax your head, neck, and shoulders downward until you feel a steady stretch along your hamstrings and calves.
Hold the stretch calmly with slow breaths, then soften your knees and roll back up smoothly to standing.
tips: Soften your knees enough to feel the stretch in your thighs without pulling on your lower back.
Hold still at a comfortable depth without bouncing.
